## Description

The parent session adopts a scratch git repo, plans two small dependent tasks, and runs a real execute-phase with subagents. watch runs in an isolated tmux server; a capture loop logs each distinct frame with a timestamp to a frame log. The log is kept for the user to review and sign.

payload.title: Watch a real execute-phase wave on a scratch effort
